description: IBCS stacked columns (D9, CO 1.1): periods on x, up to six ordered structure elements, scenario notation on the first segment, lighter grays above, inside segment values, net totals and an integrated end legend.

fields.Period: text, period on the x axis; sort the visual by period ascending (query order is retained)
fields.Segment: text, structure element; at most 6 across the visual, with one row per Period/Segment; aggregate the rest upstream
fields.SegmentOrder: optional numeric field, consistent per Segment: ascending stack order, first element at zero; absent elements sort by Segment name after ordered elements
fields.Value: measure, additive segment value; negative values stack below zero; zero has no mark, BLANK has no mark or segment label
fields.Scenario: text, AC | FC | PY | PL | BU; identical on every row of a Period; only the first drawable ordered segment carries this notation
fields.PxPerUnit: optional measure, same positive value on every row: px per display unit for the page scale group; wins over pxPerUnit

ibcs.notes: Follows the IBCS® Standards. The first drawable structure element per period in the global SegmentOrder (or Segment name order) carries the column scenario in the stack: AC solid dark, PY light, PL/BU outlined, FC hatched. The five upper shades interpolate between the existing ibcsGray2 and ibcsAssistArea tokens; no independent palette. Thin white separators use ibcsBackground (the default page background). SegmentOrder and Scenario must be consistent; aggregate duplicate Period/Segment rows upstream. Negative segment values stack below the baseline independently of positives, in the same segment order (the first element remains at zero); totals are the signed net sum and sit above the positive stack, or below an all-negative stack. Null Value is omitted, not converted to zero; totals sum available values, and entirely blank periods are dropped. This composition template has no reference comparison, relative variance or polarity colours; the PY sample periods exercise negative, zero and null inputs without division. Rows with a blank Period or Segment, or no valid Value, are dropped; Scenario and PxPerUnit alone do not retain unknown members. FC inside labels have an ibcsBackground halo over the hatch. Inside labels need at least minLabelPx of actual rendered height; very narrow columns may need fewer decimals, scaled measures or a larger stepScale/container. The integrated legend connects the last period’s segment midpoints to names separated by at least max(legendGapPx, ibcsFontSize + 2) pixels; legendOffsetPx reserves horizontal leader room. Supply every segment in the last period; zero/blank segments there cannot be labelled. Reserve enough plot height for the legend names at this gap. One value scale spans both signs: equal pxPerUnit across visuals plus container heights sized to each visual's own signed stack range (CH 4.1/4.2); an undersized container shrinks the scale without clipping. stepScale defaults to 1.5, matching the other column templates; keep it identical across the page. Font family and number locale come from the synced Deneb config. SVG rendering is required for FC. stacked bars: use structure orientation later. Desktop interaction and hatch rendering still need verification in Deneb. Columns fill 2/3 of their slot; same column width across visuals (e.g. the month chart and its total): set barPx.

tiers.range: min(0, sum of negative Value per Period) … max(0, sum of positive Value per Period), after unitDivisor

layout.rule: container height = fixedPx + (hi − lo) × pxPerUnit + labelPx (+ labelPx again when lo < 0); fixedPx measured with Vega-Lite 6.4.3 at ibcsFontSize 12; use fixedPxNoCategoryLabels when showCategoryLabels = false; stepScale = 1.5 by default; columns fill 2/3 of their slot (barPx for one width across visuals); reserve right padding for legendOffsetPx + 4 px + the widest segment name, and plot height at least ibcsFontSize + (visible legend names − 1) × max(legendGapPx, ibcsFontSize + 2)

previewVariants.description: Synthetic AC/FC months with thin East/South top segments, an FC period whose first segment is zero, and blank/unknown members that must disappear. Uses the default stepScale 1.5.

params.name: decimals
params.description: label precision applied to ibcsFmtAbs; bind scaled measures so chart labels need at most 3 digits

params.name: unitDivisor
params.description: divides Value before drawing and labelling; 1 = already scaled measures, 1000 = thousands, 1000000 = millions; put the unit in the title

params.name: periodType
params.description: year | quarter | month | week | day: category width per period type (UN 3.3)

params.name: stepScale
params.description: screen scaling of the token category step; default 1.5 matches the other column templates; keep identical across the page

params.name: barPx
params.description: column width in px; 0 = 2/3 of the category slot. Set the same value in every visual of one period type on a page (e.g. 2/3 of the month slot) so their columns have the same width

params.name: pxPerUnit
params.description: px per display unit after unitDivisor; 0 = auto. A positive PxPerUnit field wins. Size the container to its own signed stack range using usermeta.ibcs.layout; if too small, the data wins and the scale shrinks

params.name: minLabelPx
params.description: minimum segment height in rendered pixels for an inside value label; the font height plus separators is also respected

params.name: legendGapPx
params.description: minimum vertical centre-to-centre gap in pixels between end-legend names; at least ibcsFontSize + 2 is always respected

params.name: legendOffsetPx
params.description: horizontal distance in pixels from the last column edge to the end of each legend leader; names start another 4 px to the right; minimum 4 px

params.name: labelPad
params.description: total-label room as a share of the signed data range when pxPerUnit = 0

params.name: labelPx
params.description: total-label room in pixels when pxPerUnit > 0

params.name: showCategoryLabels
params.description: false hides period labels, e.g. when another aligned visual already shows them

datum._lo < 0 ? datum._lo - (datum._ppu > 0 ? labelPx / datum._ppu : max(datum._hi - datum._lo, 1) * labelPad) : datum._lo
datum._ppu > 0 ? max(datum._hi + labelPx / datum._ppu, datum._lo + height / datum._ppu) : datum._hi + max(datum._hi - datum._lo, 1) * labelPad
isValid(datum._v) ? format(abs(datum._v) * pow(10, decimals) < 0.5 ? 0 : datum._v, replace(ibcsFmtAbs, /[.][0-9]+/, '.' + decimals)) : ''
isValid(datum._total) ? format(abs(datum._total) * pow(10, decimals) < 0.5 ? 0 : datum._total, replace(ibcsFmtAbs, /[.][0-9]+/, '.' + decimals)) : ''

layer.description: invisible signed extent owns the shared value scale; other layers use that scale for positions, so absent scenarios do not create empty extent domains; with pxPerUnit the domain is plot height ÷ pxPerUnit when the data fits
cross-filter selection: assist the whole period, without dimming scenario notation
one continuous zero baseline, behind the columns
opaque FC ground, before the hatched first segment
the lowest drawable structure element of each column (first non-blank, non-zero in order) carries the column scenario, even when negative

fill.expr: datum.Scenario == 'FC' ? pbiPatternSVG(ibcsHatch, ibcsFCStripe, ibcsFCGround) : datum.Scenario == 'PY' ? ibcsPY : (datum.Scenario == 'PL' || datum.Scenario == 'BU') ? ibcsPLFill : ibcsAC

layer.description: upper structure elements: discrete segments sampled from a token-based gray ramp, lighter in stack order
thin white separators only at adjoining segment boundaries, not around outlined scenario segments
background-coloured halo behind the drawable FC scenario segment’s inside label, so hatch stripes do not cut through text

opacity.expr: abs(scale('y', datum._s1) - scale('y', datum._s0)) >= max(minLabelPx, ibcsFontSize + 2 * ibcsOutline) ? 1 : 0

layer.description: inside values only where the actual pixel height fits the label; no label for zero or blank segments

opacity.expr: abs(scale('y', datum._s1) - scale('y', datum._s0)) >= max(minLabelPx, ibcsFontSize + 2 * ibcsOutline) ? 1 : 0

layer.description: signed net total above a stack that has positive segments, below an all-negative stack; a blank period shows nothing (N/A is only for relative variances)
integrated end legend: retain midpoint anchors, separate names in screen pixels and connect them with offset leaders

transform.calculate: clamp(datum._legendAnchorY, ibcsFontSize / 2, height - ibcsFontSize / 2) - (datum._legendIndex - 1) * max(legendGapPx, ibcsFontSize + 2)

layer.description: leaders from true segment midpoints to the separated name positions

value.expr: scale('x', datum.Period) + bandwidth('x') / 2 + (barPx > 0 ? min(bandwidth('x'), barPx) : bandwidth('x')) / 2 + 2
scale('x', datum.Period) + bandwidth('x') / 2 + (barPx > 0 ? min(bandwidth('x'), barPx) : bandwidth('x')) / 2 + max(legendOffsetPx, 4)
